    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceAttended" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_8" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_9" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Owner" name="Car owner service and payment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Owner">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CarOwner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ServiceReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GoToService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoToService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrRepair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_StatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_RepairCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PaymentCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceReminder" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GoToService" name="Go to service?"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GoToService" name="Go to car service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoService" name="Do not go to service"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrRepair" name="Wait for status update or completed repair"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_StatusUpdate" name="Receive status update by email">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Message_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentCompleted" name="Payment completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceReminder" targetRef="Gateway_GoToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_Go" name="Go" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="Task_GoToService">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${goToService}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_NoGo" name="Do not go" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="End_NoService" default="true"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_2" sourceRef="Task_GoToService" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrRepair" targetRef="Catch_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrRepair" targetRef="Catch_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_5" sourceRef="Catch_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_6" sourceRef="Catch_RepairCompleted" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_7" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="End_PaymentCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car service facility work" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Facility">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ServiceVisit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterRepairSuccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Facility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceVisit" name="Car brought for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceVisit" messageRef="Message_ServiceVisit"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send status update by email"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDone" name="Repair done?" default="Flow_RepairNotDone"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Facility" name="Service information recorded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceVisit" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairDone}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairNotDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service and next service time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceVisit" name="Car brought for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Service status update by email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCompleted" name="Repair successful and Pickerl recorded"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService" name="Car Service">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_App" name="Police app" processRef="Process_App"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car owner" processRef="Process_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car service facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service and next service time recorded"
                      sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="Start_SuccessfulService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder" name="Service reminder"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Start_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceVisit" name="Bring car for service"
                      sourceRef="Task_BringCar" targetRef="Start_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"
                      sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Status update by email"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Catch_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairCompleted" name="Repair successful and Pickerl recorded"
                      sourceRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="Catch_RepairCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_App" name="Car service reminders" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_App">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AppSystem" name="Police app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_SuccessfulService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_NextServiceTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceAttended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ServiceAttended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueFine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service recorded">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SuccessfulService" messageRef="Message_SuccessfulService"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_NextServiceTime" name="Next service time arrives">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_NextServiceTime">
        <bpmn:timeDate>${nextServiceTime}</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check if car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" name="Wait for service or 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceAttended" messageRef="Message_ServiceAttended"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueFine" name="Fine car owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Fine issued"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_1" sourceRef="Start_SuccessfulService" targetRef="Catch_NextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_2" sourceRef="Catch_NextServiceTime" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceAttended" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_8" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_9" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Owner" name="Car owner service and payment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Owner">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CarOwner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Reminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GoToService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoServiceVisit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BringCar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrCompletion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_StatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_RepairCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PaymentCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Reminder" name="Service reminder received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Reminder" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GoToService" name="Go to the service?" default="Flow_NoServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoServiceVisit" name="No service visit"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringCar" name="Bring car to service"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeUpdates" name="Continue waiting for repair updates"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrCompletion" name="Wait for status update or completed repair"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_StatusUpdate" name="Receive status update by email">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Message_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentCompleted" name="Payment completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_1" sourceRef="Start_Reminder" targetRef="Gateway_GoToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoToService" name="Go to service" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="Task_BringCar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${goToService}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoServiceVisit" name="Do not go to service" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="End_NoServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_2" sourceRef="Task_BringCar" targetRef="Gateway_MergeUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_3" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrCompletion" targetRef="Catch_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdateOrCompletion" targetRef="Catch_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_6" sourceRef="Catch_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_MergeUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_7" sourceRef="Catch_RepairCompleted" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_8" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="End_PaymentCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car service facility work" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Facility">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ServiceVisit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitForRepair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterRepairSuccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Facility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceVisit" name="Car brought for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceVisit" messageRef="Message_ServiceVisit"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitForRepair" name="Wait for repair to be done"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send status update by email"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDone" name="Is the repair done?" default="Flow_RepairNotDone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Facility" name="Service information recorded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceVisit" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_WaitForRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_WaitForRepair" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${repairDone}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairNotDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_WaitForRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
